role: exploratory: can a local model rank which turns to escalate better than the specialist's own confidence?
claim: In workflow v2 the 9B orchestrator won by spotting out-of-scope turns and almost never escalated, so it said nothing about routing. Here escalation is forced to fixed rates and only the ranking differs: which turns get sent to the stronger worker. Same sessions, workers, decisions and success rule as workflow v1 and v2. Written before the few-shot orchestrator was run and before any ranking in this file was scored.
scope_gate: every policy here uses the same gate: the workflow v2 orchestrator with confidences marks a turn out of scope when action 4 has its highest probability. Rankers differ only in which of the remaining turns they escalate.

rankers.encoder_confidence: ascending top probability of the encoder
rankers.orchestrator_zero_shot: the workflow v2 orchestrator with confidences: probability of actions 2 and 3 divided by the probability of actions 1, 2 and 3, already saved in artifacts/workflow-v2/actions.json
rankers.orchestrator_few_shot: the same model and prompt preceded by ten worked examples from dev, scored the same way
rankers.combined: the mean of the within-pool ranks under encoder_confidence and orchestrator_few_shot
rankers.random: uniform over the remaining turns, mean of 200 draws with seed 20261011
rankers.oracle: turns where accepting the encoder would be wrong and the target worker's answer would be right, first; a bound, uses gold

few_shot.examples: four dev utterances the encoder classified correctly (answer: action 1), four it got wrong (answer: action 2), and two CLINC150 out-of-scope validation queries (answer: action 4), drawn with seed 20261011 and shown in a shuffled order as earlier turns of the chat, each in the workflow v2 prompt with the encoder's top three guesses and probabilities
few_shot.labels_used: the gold intents of those eight Banking77 dev items and the out-of-scope status of the two queries; no session item

rate_meaning: share of all 2000 turns escalated; the top-ranked turns among those the gate left in scope
metrics: ranking quality: AUROC of each ranker for 'accepting the encoder here would be wrong', over the turns the gate left in scope
turn and session success at each rate and target, with 95% bootstrap intervals over sessions
the no-escalation baseline under the same gate
